pets: clarify the Appetite stat tooltip. 'Appetite' is dual-purpose — the HATCHED gene value prices food (feedBlocks = value/(appetite*FEED_DIV), locked forever), and as a battle stat it's 'bulk & bite' (+HP, +damage). Training Appetite only grows the trained bonus + power (which feed battle), never the frozen on-chain ap that prices food — so it's free muscle with no bigger food bill. The old tooltip ('also sets food cost') read like training it would make the pet eat more; reworded to say food cost is fixed at hatch and training is free upside. Display-string only, no stat/gene math touched

games: AUTO-COLLECT everywhere, not just slots. coinflip, dice, roulette and poker now settle a resolved WIN for you automatically (a value-free settle → auto-signs, a quick bounce): the winner's coinflip pot, a winning dice roll / roulette spin seat, and the poker pot to the hand's leader all collect themselves the moment the chain decides — one per refresh tick, an autoTried guard stops a rejected settle from looping, and it only ever settles YOUR winnings (losers/bank untouched). chess: Flip board now works for BLACK too. The orientation was 'flipBoard || side===b' — an OR that pinned black's board to the flipped view permanently, so a black player could never rotate to white's-eye view. Made it XOR (flipBoard !== isBlack): each side starts oriented to itself and the button genuinely inverts it either way

chess: 'Offer draw' is no longer a silent no-op. agree(3) always worked on-chain (contract only needs nn==2 & unsettled), but nothing surfaced the offer: after you offered, the button still said 'Offer draw' and your opponent saw no change, so it felt dead. Now the button reflects state — '½ Offer draw' → '½ Draw offered — waiting for opponent…' once you've offered, and when your OPPONENT offers it flips to a pulsing '🤝 Accept draw — refund both stakes' plus a one-time banner. Same agree(3) handler accepts
